items.question: Trong câu "He stated a business objective.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "He stated a business objective.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. "Business objective" = mục tiêu kinh doanh. Là tính từ, objective lại nghĩa là khách quan.
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒek.tɪv/ (noun): an aim or goal. "Business objective" is a business goal. As an adjective, objective means unbiased.

items.question: Trong câu "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", từ "adequate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", what does "adequate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adequate /ˈæd.ɪ.kwət/ (tính từ): đầy đủ, thỏa đáng. "Adequate involvement" = sự tham gia đủ mức cần thiết. Trái nghĩa: inadequate.
items.explanationEn: adequate /ˈæd.ɪ.kwət/ (adjective): sufficient, enough. "Adequate involvement" means enough participation. Opposite: inadequate.

items.question: Trong câu "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", từ "inescapable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", what does "inescapable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inescapable /ˌɪn.ɪˈskeɪ.pə.bəl/ (tính từ): không thể tránh khỏi. "Inescapable outcome" = kết cục không tránh được. Gần nghĩa: inevitable.
items.explanationEn: inescapable /ˌɪn.ɪˈskeɪ.pə.bəl/ (adjective): impossible to avoid. "Inescapable outcome" means a result you cannot avoid. Synonym: inevitable.

items.question: Trong câu "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", từ "gulf" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without adequate customer involvement, the inescapable outcome is an expectation gap — a gulf between what customers really need and what developers deliver based on what they heard at the beginning of the project.", what does "gulf" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gulf /ɡʌlf/ (danh từ): khoảng cách lớn. "A gulf between A and B" = khoảng cách sâu giữa A và B. Nghĩa địa lý: vịnh.
items.explanationEn: gulf /ɡʌlf/ (noun): a wide separation. "A gulf between A and B" is a wide divide between them. Geographic sense: a large bay.

items.question: Trong câu "The only way to narrow that gap is frequent contact points with suitable customer representatives:", từ "narrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The only way to narrow that gap is frequent contact points with suitable customer representatives:", what does "narrow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (động từ): thu hẹp. "Narrow the gap" = thu hẹp khoảng cách. Là tính từ, narrow nghĩa là hẹp.
items.explanationEn: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (verb): to make smaller. "Narrow the gap" means reduce the distance. As an adjective, narrow means not wide.

items.question: Trong câu "With agile: user feedback on each small increment of executable software.", từ "increment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With agile: user feedback on each small increment of executable software.", what does "increment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (danh từ): phần bổ sung thêm. "Increment" = phần tăng thêm; trong agile là mỗi phần phần mềm chạy được giao thêm. Tính từ: incremental.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.mənt/ (noun): an added portion. "Increment" is an added piece; in agile, each small addition of working software. Adjective: incremental.

items.question: Trong câu "Immediately after each contact the gap starts widening again as development proceeds — so the more frequent the contact points, the closer the delivered product tracks the real need.", từ "widen" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Immediately after each contact the gap starts widening again as development proceeds — so the more frequent the contact points, the closer the delivered product tracks the real need.", what does "widen" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: widen /ˈwaɪ.dən/ (động từ): mở rộng ra. "The gap widens" = khoảng cách ngày càng rộng. Trái nghĩa: narrow.
items.explanationEn: widen /ˈwaɪ.dən/ (verb): to become wider. "The gap widens" means it grows larger. Opposite: narrow.

items.question: Trong câu "A true story: a development team built a new internal information system having obtained negligible user input.", từ "negligible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A true story: a development team built a new internal information system having obtained negligible user input.", what does "negligible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negligible /ˈneɡ.lɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): không đáng kể. "Negligible input" = đóng góp ít đến mức không đáng kể. Đừng nhầm với negligent (cẩu thả).
items.explanationEn: negligible /ˈneɡ.lɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): too small to matter. "Negligible input" is so little it hardly counts. Do not confuse with negligent (careless).

items.question: Trong câu "On unveiling day the users rejected it as completely unacceptable.", từ "unveil" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On unveiling day the users rejected it as completely unacceptable.", what does "unveil" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: unveil /ʌnˈveɪl/ (động từ): ra mắt, công bố. "Unveil" = ra mắt, công bố lần đầu (nghĩa đen: vén tấm màn).
items.explanationEn: unveil /ʌnˈveɪl/ (verb): to reveal publicly. "Unveil" means show something publicly for the first time (literally, remove a veil).

items.question: Trong câu "Developers were chagrined, users were unhappy, executives were upset about wasted money and the opportunity cost.", từ "opportunity cost" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Developers were chagrined, users were unhappy, executives were upset about wasted money and the opportunity cost.", what does "opportunity cost" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: opportunity cost /ˌɒp.əˈtjuː.nə.ti kɒst/ (cụm từ): chi phí cơ hội. "Opportunity cost" = giá trị của phương án bị bỏ lỡ; ở đây dự án tiếp theo phải chờ.
items.explanationEn: opportunity cost /ˌɒp.əˈtjuː.nə.ti kɒst/ (phrase): value of the forgone alternative. "Opportunity cost" is the value of what you gave up; here, the next project had to wait.

items.question: Trong câu "Companies always fix the system when they get the requirements wrong — and it always costs far more than engaging user representatives from the outset.", từ "outset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Companies always fix the system when they get the requirements wrong — and it always costs far more than engaging user representatives from the outset.", what does "outset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outset /ˈaʊt.set/ (danh từ): lúc bắt đầu. "From the outset" = ngay từ đầu. Cụm tương tự: at the outset.
items.explanationEn: outset /ˈaʊt.set/ (noun): the beginning. "From the outset" means from the very start. Similar: at the outset.

items.question: Trong câu "A stakeholder is a person, group, or organization that is actively involved in a project, is affected by its process or outcome, or can influence its process or outcome.", từ "influence" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stakeholder is a person, group, or organization that is actively involved in a project, is affected by its process or outcome, or can influence its process or outcome.", what does "influence" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (động từ): gây ảnh hưởng. "Influence a decision" = tác động đến quyết định. Cũng là danh từ: sự ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: influence /ˈɪn.flu.əns/ (verb): to have an effect on. "Influence a decision" means have an effect on it. Also a noun: an effect or power.

items.question: Trong câu "A customer is an individual or organization that derives either direct or indirect benefit from a product.", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A customer is an individual or organization that derives either direct or indirect benefit from a product.", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): nhận được, thu được. "Derive benefit from" = thu được lợi ích từ. Trong toán, derive còn là suy ra, lấy đạo hàm.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from. "Derive benefit from" means gain benefit from. In maths, derive also means work out or differentiate.

items.question: Trong câu "Users (end users) are a subset of customers — the people who actually operate the product.", từ "subset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users (end users) are a subset of customers — the people who actually operate the product.", what does "subset" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: subset /ˈsʌb.set/ (danh từ): tập con. "A subset of" = một tập con nằm trong tập lớn hơn.
items.explanationEn: subset /ˈsʌb.set/ (noun): a smaller set inside. "A subset of" is a group contained within a larger group.

items.question: Trong câu "They are usually too far removed from the daily work to do so accurately.", từ "removed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are usually too far removed from the daily work to do so accurately.", what does "removed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: removed /rɪˈmuːvd/ (tính từ): cách xa, tách biệt. "Far removed from" = cách xa, không gần gũi với thực tế công việc.
items.explanationEn: removed /rɪˈmuːvd/ (adjective): distant, disconnected. "Far removed from" means distant from, out of touch with.

items.question: Trong câu "If there is a serious disconnect between the acquiring customer who pays and the end users, major problems are guaranteed.", từ "disconnect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If there is a serious disconnect between the acquiring customer who pays and the end users, major problems are guaranteed.", what does "disconnect" (noun) mean?
options: sự vênh nhau, thiếu gắn kết
items.explanation: disconnect /ˌdɪs.kəˈnekt/ (danh từ): sự vênh nhau, thiếu gắn kết. "A disconnect between A and B" = A và B không hiểu nhau, lệch nhau.
items.explanationEn: disconnect /ˌdɪs.kəˈnekt/ (noun): a lack of alignment. "A disconnect between A and B" means they are out of step with each other.

items.question: Trong câu "When they finally met, a long list of missed requirements around the legal implications appeared, and the project was delayed several months.", từ "implication" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When they finally met, a long list of missed requirements around the legal implications appeared, and the project was delayed several months.", what does "implication" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: implication /ˌɪm.plɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hệ quả, tác động. "Legal implications" = hệ quả về pháp lý. Nghĩa khác: sự ngụ ý, ám chỉ.
items.explanationEn: implication /ˌɪm.plɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a likely consequence. "Legal implications" are the legal consequences. Another sense: something suggested indirectly.

items.question: Trong câu "An excellent product results from a well-executed design based on excellent requirements.", từ "result from" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An excellent product results from a well-executed design based on excellent requirements.", what does "result from" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: result from /rɪˈzʌlt frɒm/ (cụm từ): bắt nguồn từ. "A results from B" = A là kết quả của B. Ngược lại: "B results in A".
items.explanationEn: result from /rɪˈzʌlt frɒm/ (phrase): to be caused by. "A results from B" means B causes A. The reverse is "B results in A".

items.question: Trong câu "Excellent requirements result from effective collaboration between developers and customers — a partnership, not a one-way handover.", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Excellent requirements result from effective collaboration between developers and customers — a partnership, not a one-way handover.", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cộng tác. "Collaboration between A and B" = sự hợp tác giữa A và B. Tính từ: collaborative.
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæb.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): working together. "Collaboration between A and B" means them working together. Adjective: collaborative.

items.question: Trong câu "Excellent requirements result from effective collaboration between developers and customers — a partnership, not a one-way handover.", từ "handover" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Excellent requirements result from effective collaboration between developers and customers — a partnership, not a one-way handover.", what does "handover" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handover /ˈhænd.əʊ.vər/ (danh từ): sự bàn giao. "A one-way handover" = bàn giao một chiều rồi thôi. Động từ: hand over.
items.explanationEn: handover /ˈhænd.əʊ.vər/ (noun): passing responsibility on. "A one-way handover" is passing something on with no dialogue. Verb: hand over.

items.question: Trong câu "The business analyst is typically the point person who has to forge this partnership.", từ "forge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business analyst is typically the point person who has to forge this partnership.", what does "forge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (động từ): xây dựng, tạo dựng. "Forge a partnership" = gây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác. Nghĩa khác: rèn (kim loại), làm giả (chữ ký).
items.explanationEn: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (verb): to build, to create. "Forge a partnership" means build one through effort. Other senses: shape metal, fake a signature.

items.question: Trong câu "To make that concrete rather than a slogan, Wiegers proposes two symmetrical lists: a Bill of Rights (10 customer rights) and a Bill of Responsibilities (10 customer responsibilities).", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To make that concrete rather than a slogan, Wiegers proposes two symmetrical lists: a Bill of Rights (10 customer rights) and a Bill of Responsibilities (10 customer responsibilities).", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Make it concrete" = biến ý tưởng thành điều cụ thể. Danh từ concrete là bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (adjective): specific and real. "Make it concrete" means turn an idea into something specific. The noun concrete is a building material.

items.question: Trong câu "The flip side of a right is always a responsibility.", từ "flip side" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The flip side of a right is always a responsibility.", what does "flip side" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: flip side /ˈflɪp saɪd/ (cụm từ): mặt còn lại. "The flip side of X" = mặt đối ứng của X; quyền luôn đi kèm trách nhiệm.
items.explanationEn: flip side /ˈflɪp saɪd/ (phrase): the other aspect. "The flip side of X" is its counterpart; every right comes with a responsibility.

items.question: Trong câu "Early in the project, have the key stakeholders review both lists and negotiate to reach a meeting of the minds.", từ "meeting of the minds" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Early in the project, have the key stakeholders review both lists and negotiate to reach a meeting of the minds.", what does "meeting of the minds" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: meeting of the minds /ˈmiː.tɪŋ əv ðə maɪndz/ (cụm từ): sự đồng thuận. "Reach a meeting of the minds" = đạt được sự hiểu và đồng ý chung.
items.explanationEn: meeting of the minds /ˈmiː.tɪŋ əv ðə maɪndz/ (phrase): a shared agreement. "Reach a meeting of the minds" means arrive at a shared understanding and agreement.

items.question: Trong câu "Early in the project, have the key stakeholders review both lists and negotiate to reach a meeting of the minds.", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Early in the project, have the key stakeholders review both lists and negotiate to reach a meeting of the minds.", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): thương lượng. "Negotiate an agreement" = thương lượng để đạt thỏa thuận. Danh từ: negotiation.
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to discuss to agree. "Negotiate an agreement" means discuss terms until both sides agree. Noun: negotiation.

items.question: Trong câu "This reduces friction later, when one party expects something the other is not willing or able to provide.", từ "friction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This reduces friction later, when one party expects something the other is not willing or able to provide.", what does "friction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: friction /ˈfrɪk.ʃən/ (danh từ): va chạm, bất đồng. "Reduce friction" = giảm va chạm giữa các bên. Nghĩa vật lý: lực ma sát.
items.explanationEn: friction /ˈfrɪk.ʃən/ (noun): conflict, tension. "Reduce friction" means reduce tension between people. Physics sense: resistance between surfaces.

items.question: Trong câu "You should not have to wade through technical jargon.", từ "wade through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You should not have to wade through technical jargon.", what does "wade through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wade through /weɪd θruː/ (cụm từ): vật lộn đọc qua. "Wade through" = vất vả đọc/xử lý một thứ dài, khó. Nghĩa đen: lội qua nước.
items.explanationEn: wade through /weɪd θruː/ (phrase): to struggle through. "Wade through" means work slowly through something tedious. Literally, walk through water.

items.question: Trong câu "You should not have to wade through technical jargon.", từ "jargon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You should not have to wade through technical jargon.", what does "jargon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ chuyên môn. "Technical jargon" = thuật ngữ kỹ thuật khó hiểu với người ngoài ngành.
items.explanationEn: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (noun): specialist terms. "Technical jargon" is specialist language outsiders find hard to follow.

items.question: Trong câu "Receive explanations of requirements practices and deliverables.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Receive explanations of requirements practices and deliverables.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. "Deliverables" = các sản phẩm/tài liệu phải bàn giao trong dự án.
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output to hand over. "Deliverables" are the outputs a project must hand over, such as documents or diagrams.

items.question: Trong câu "It is not realistic to expect you to think of everything up front.", từ "up front" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is not realistic to expect you to think of everything up front.", what does "up front" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "Up front" = trước, ngay từ đầu. Cũng có nghĩa thẳng thắn ("be up front about").
items.explanationEn: up front /ʌp ˈfrʌnt/ (phrase): in advance, at the start. "Up front" means in advance. It can also mean frank ("be up front about").

items.question: Trong câu "But change always has a price — sometimes a trade-off against other functions, or against schedule and budget.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But change always has a price — sometimes a trade-off against other functions, or against schedule and budget.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance of gains and losses
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "A trade-off against X" = đánh đổi, được cái này mất cái kia.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance of gains and losses. "A trade-off against X" means gaining one thing by giving up another.

items.question: Trong câu "Expect an environment of mutual respect.", từ "mutual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Expect an environment of mutual respect.", what does "mutual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mutual /ˈmjuː.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): lẫn nhau. "Mutual respect" = tôn trọng lẫn nhau. Cụm: mutual benefit, mutual trust.
items.explanationEn: mutual /ˈmjuː.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): shared by both sides. "Mutual respect" is respect felt by both sides. Also: mutual benefit, mutual trust.

items.question: Trong câu "Hear about ways to adjust requirements to accelerate development through reuse.", từ "accelerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hear about ways to adjust requirements to accelerate development through reuse.", what does "accelerate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accelerate /əkˈsel.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): đẩy nhanh. "Accelerate development" = đẩy nhanh việc phát triển. Danh từ: acceleration.
items.explanationEn: accelerate /əkˈsel.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to speed up. "Accelerate development" means make it go faster. Noun: acceleration.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA may know of an existing component that comes close to your need; a small adjustment can save considerable time and money.", từ "considerable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA may know of an existing component that comes close to your need; a small adjustment can save considerable time and money.", what does "considerable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: considerable /kənˈsɪd.ər.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): đáng kể. "Considerable time" = lượng thời gian đáng kể. Đừng nhầm với considerate (chu đáo).
items.explanationEn: considerable /kənˈsɪd.ər.ə.bəl/ (adjective): fairly large. "Considerable time" is a large amount of time. Do not confuse with considerate (thoughtful).

items.question: Trong câu "This is the ultimate right — but it only happens if you clearly state all your assumptions and expectations.", từ "ultimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the ultimate right — but it only happens if you clearly state all your assumptions and expectations.", what does "ultimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ultimate /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət/ (tính từ): cao nhất, sau cùng. "The ultimate goal" = mục tiêu cuối cùng, quan trọng nhất. Trạng từ: ultimately.
items.explanationEn: ultimate /ˈʌl.tɪ.mət/ (adjective): final and most important. "The ultimate goal" is the final, most important one. Adverb: ultimately.

items.question: Trong câu "The intent is not to turn BAs into business experts, but to help them understand your problems and objectives.", từ "intent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The intent is not to turn BAs into business experts, but to help them understand your problems and objectives.", what does "intent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (danh từ): ý định, mục đích. "The intent is to..." = mục đích là... Tính từ: intentional.
items.explanationEn: intent /ɪnˈtent/ (noun): a purpose. "The intent is to..." means the purpose is to... Adjective: intentional.

items.question: Trong câu "Dedicate the time it takes to provide and clarify requirements.", từ "dedicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dedicate the time it takes to provide and clarify requirements.", what does "dedicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dedicate /ˈded.ɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): dành riêng. "Dedicate time to something" = dành thời gian cho việc gì. Tính từ: dedicated (chuyên dụng, tận tâm).
items.explanationEn: dedicate /ˈded.ɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to set aside for. "Dedicate time to something" means set time aside for it. Adjective: dedicated.

items.question: Trong câu "Several focused hours beat the same total time scattered in fragments over weeks.", từ "scattered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Several focused hours beat the same total time scattered in fragments over weeks.", what does "scattered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: scattered /ˈskæt.əd/ (tính từ): rải rác. "Scattered in fragments" = rải rác thành từng mảnh nhỏ. Động từ: scatter.
items.explanationEn: scattered /ˈskæt.əd/ (adjective): spread out. "Scattered in fragments" means spread out in small pieces. Verb: scatter.

items.question: Trong câu "Leaving requirements vague means someone must resolve the ambiguity later — and you are the best person to do it, rather than leaving developers to guess.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leaving requirements vague means someone must resolve the ambiguity later — and you are the best person to do it, rather than leaving developers to guess.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ. "Vague requirements" = yêu cầu mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. Trái nghĩa: precise, specific.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear. "Vague requirements" are unclear ones. Opposites: precise, specific.

items.question: Trong câu "Leaving requirements vague means someone must resolve the ambiguity later — and you are the best person to do it, rather than leaving developers to guess.", từ "ambiguity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Leaving requirements vague means someone must resolve the ambiguity later — and you are the best person to do it, rather than leaving developers to guess.", what does "ambiguity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (danh từ): sự nhập nhằng. "Resolve the ambiguity" = làm rõ chỗ có thể hiểu nhiều cách. Tính từ: ambiguous.
items.explanationEn: ambiguity /ˌæm.bɪˈɡjuː.ə.ti/ (noun): having several meanings. "Resolve the ambiguity" means clear up what can be read in more than one way. Adjective: ambiguous.

items.question: Trong câu "Make timely decisions when asked.", từ "timely" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make timely decisions when asked.", what does "timely" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (tính từ): kịp thời. "Timely decisions" = quyết định kịp thời. Dù có đuôi -ly, timely là tính từ.
items.explanationEn: timely /ˈtaɪm.li/ (adjective): done at the right time. "Timely decisions" are made promptly. Despite the -ly ending, timely is an adjective.

items.question: Trong câu "Developers often cannot proceed with confidence until you render your decision.", từ "render" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Developers often cannot proceed with confidence until you render your decision.", what does "render" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: render /ˈren.dər/ (động từ): đưa ra (quyết định). "Render a decision" = đưa ra quyết định (trang trọng). Trong frontend, render là hiển thị giao diện.
items.explanationEn: render /ˈren.dər/ (verb): to give or deliver. "Render a decision" means deliver one (formal). In front-end work, render means draw the UI.

items.question: Trong câu "Respect a developer assessment of cost and feasibility.", từ "assessment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Respect a developer assessment of cost and feasibility.", what does "assessment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assessment /əˈses.mənt/ (danh từ): sự đánh giá. "An assessment of cost" = đánh giá, ước tính chi phí. Động từ: assess.
items.explanationEn: assessment /əˈses.mənt/ (noun): an evaluation. "An assessment of cost" is an evaluation of it. Verb: assess.

items.question: Trong câu "Promptly communicate changes to the requirements.", từ "promptly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Promptly communicate changes to the requirements.", what does "promptly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Promptly" = nhanh chóng, không chậm trễ. Tính từ: prompt.
items.explanationEn: promptly /ˈprɒmpt.li/ (adverb): without delay. "Promptly" means quickly, without delay. Adjective: prompt.

items.question: Trong câu "Feel free to ask why the BA needs certain information — but trust that there is a rationale behind their approach.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Feel free to ask why the BA needs certain information — but trust that there is a rationale behind their approach.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do cơ sở. "A rationale behind something" = lý lẽ, cơ sở đằng sau một cách làm.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the underlying reason. "A rationale behind something" is the reasoning that supports it.

items.question: Trong câu "You will meet resistance.", từ "resistance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will meet resistance.", what does "resistance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: resistance /rɪˈzɪs.təns/ (danh từ): sự phản kháng. "Meet resistance" = gặp sự phản đối. Trong vật lý, resistance là điện trở.
items.explanationEn: resistance /rɪˈzɪs.təns/ (noun): opposition. "Meet resistance" means face opposition. In physics, resistance is opposition to current.

items.question: Trong câu "Some people regard requirements work as bureaucratic overhead; others suffered through a large, incomplete, ultimately ignored requirements specification.", từ "regard as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some people regard requirements work as bureaucratic overhead; others suffered through a large, incomplete, ultimately ignored requirements specification.", what does "regard as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: regard as /rɪˈɡɑːd æz/ (cụm từ): coi là. "Regard A as B" = coi A là B. "Regards" ở cuối thư lại là lời chào.
items.explanationEn: regard as /rɪˈɡɑːd æz/ (phrase): to consider to be. "Regard A as B" means consider A to be B. "Regards" at the end of a letter is a greeting.

items.question: Trong câu "Some people regard requirements work as bureaucratic overhead; others suffered through a large, incomplete, ultimately ignored requirements specification.", từ "overhead" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some people regard requirements work as bureaucratic overhead; others suffered through a large, incomplete, ultimately ignored requirements specification.", what does "overhead" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (danh từ): chi phí phụ tốn thêm. "Bureaucratic overhead" = gánh nặng thủ tục tốn thêm công sức. Trạng từ overhead: trên đầu.
items.explanationEn: overhead /ˈəʊ.və.hed/ (noun): extra cost or effort. "Bureaucratic overhead" is extra paperwork effort. As an adverb, overhead means above.

items.question: Trong câu "They have never been exposed to solid requirements practices.", từ "be exposed to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They have never been exposed to solid requirements practices.", what does "be exposed to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: be exposed to /bi ɪkˈspəʊzd tuː/ (cụm từ): được tiếp xúc với. "Be exposed to" = được tiếp xúc, trải nghiệm. Cũng có nghĩa bị lộ, bị phơi ra.
items.explanationEn: be exposed to /bi ɪkˈspəʊzd tuː/ (phrase): to have experience of. "Be exposed to" means have contact with. It can also mean be revealed or left unprotected.

items.question: Trong câu "They do not recognise the price already paid for working in a casual, unstructured way — because rework is buried in daily project activity, nobody names it as waste.", từ "bury" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They do not recognise the price already paid for working in a casual, unstructured way — because rework is buried in daily project activity, nobody names it as waste.", what does "bury" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bury /ˈber.i/ (động từ): lẫn khuất, che lấp. "Be buried in" = bị vùi lấp trong, khó nhận ra. Nghĩa đen: chôn.
items.explanationEn: bury /ˈber.i/ (verb): to hide among other things. "Be buried in" means hidden among other things. Literal sense: put underground.

items.question: Trong câu "They see what is coming, spot areas needing clarity, suggest easier ways to do things, and catch missing requirements such as exception handling.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They see what is coming, spot areas needing clarity, suggest easier ways to do things, and catch missing requirements such as exception handling.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): phát hiện ra. "Spot a problem" = phát hiện ra vấn đề. Danh từ spot là vết, chấm hoặc địa điểm.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice. "Spot a problem" means notice it. The noun spot is a mark or a place.

items.question: Trong câu "Remind leadership that business analysis capability must be treated as a strategic core competency, or improvements will evaporate once the project ends or after a reorganization.", từ "evaporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remind leadership that business analysis capability must be treated as a strategic core competency, or improvements will evaporate once the project ends or after a reorganization.", what does "evaporate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): biến mất dần. "Improvements evaporate" = cải tiến tan biến. Nghĩa khoa học: bay hơi.
items.explanationEn: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to fade away. "Improvements evaporate" means they disappear. Scientific sense: turn from liquid into vapour.

items.question: Trong câu "Remind leadership that business analysis capability must be treated as a strategic core competency, or improvements will evaporate once the project ends or after a reorganization.", từ "competency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remind leadership that business analysis capability must be treated as a strategic core competency, or improvements will evaporate once the project ends or after a reorganization.", what does "competency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: competency /ˈkɒm.pɪ.tən.si/ (danh từ): năng lực. "Core competency" = năng lực cốt lõi của tổ chức. Đừng nhầm với competition.
items.explanationEn: competency /ˈkɒm.pɪ.tən.si/ (noun): a skill or ability. "Core competency" is an organisation's key capability. Do not confuse with competition.

items.question: Trong câu "A software project involves hundreds of decisions, and many sit on the critical path.", từ "critical path" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A software project involves hundreds of decisions, and many sit on the critical path.", what does "critical path" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (cụm từ): đường găng (tiến độ). "On the critical path" = nằm trên chuỗi công việc quyết định tiến độ; chậm là trễ cả dự án.
items.explanationEn: critical path /ˈkrɪt.ɪ.kəl pɑːθ/ (phrase): the schedule-deciding chain. "On the critical path" means in the chain of tasks that sets the schedule; any delay delays the project.

items.question: Trong câu "The group votes, but the result must be unanimous.", từ "unanimous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The group votes, but the result must be unanimous.", what does "unanimous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unanimous /juːˈnæn.ɪ.məs/ (tính từ): nhất trí hoàn toàn. "Unanimous" = tất cả đều đồng ý. Đừng nhầm với anonymous (ẩn danh).
items.explanationEn: unanimous /juːˈnæn.ɪ.məs/ (adjective): agreed by everyone. "Unanimous" means everyone agrees. Do not confuse with anonymous.

items.question: Trong câu "The group negotiates to reach consensus — everyone can live with the decision and commits to supporting it.", từ "consensus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The group negotiates to reach consensus — everyone can live with the decision and commits to supporting it.", what does "consensus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (danh từ): sự đồng thuận. "Reach consensus" = đạt đồng thuận. Đừng nhầm với census (điều tra dân số).
items.explanationEn: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (noun): general agreement. "Reach consensus" means arrive at general agreement. Do not confuse with census.

items.question: Trong câu "The group negotiates to reach consensus — everyone can live with the decision and commits to supporting it.", từ "live with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The group negotiates to reach consensus — everyone can live with the decision and commits to supporting it.", what does "live with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: live with /lɪv wɪð/ (cụm từ): chấp nhận được. "Can live with a decision" = chấp nhận được dù không hoàn toàn thích.
items.explanationEn: live with /lɪv wɪð/ (phrase): to accept, to tolerate. "Can live with a decision" means accept it even if it is not your first choice.

items.question: Trong câu "The leader delegates the decision to one individual.", từ "delegate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The leader delegates the decision to one individual.", what does "delegate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): ủy quyền, giao lại. "Delegate something to someone" = giao việc/quyền cho ai. Danh từ delegate là đại biểu.
items.explanationEn: delegate /ˈdel.ɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to hand to someone else. "Delegate something to someone" means hand it to them. The noun delegate is a representative.

items.question: Trong câu "The group decides, but someone holds veto authority.", từ "veto" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The group decides, but someone holds veto authority.", what does "veto" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: veto /ˈviː.təʊ/ (danh từ): quyền phủ quyết. "Veto authority" = quyền phủ quyết, chặn một quyết định. Cũng là động từ: veto a proposal.
items.explanationEn: veto /ˈviː.təʊ/ (noun): the power to block. "Veto authority" is the power to block a decision. Also a verb: veto a proposal.

items.question: Trong câu "Set guidelines so you know when to vote, when to seek consensus, and when to delegate — and choose before you confront the first significant decision.", từ "confront" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Set guidelines so you know when to vote, when to seek consensus, and when to delegate — and choose before you confront the first significant decision.", what does "confront" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confront /kənˈfrʌnt/ (động từ): đối mặt với. "Confront a problem" = đối mặt với vấn đề. Danh từ: confrontation.
items.explanationEn: confront /kənˈfrʌnt/ (verb): to face. "Confront a problem" means face it directly. Noun: confrontation.

items.question: Trong câu "Testers agree the requirements are verifiable.", từ "verifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Testers agree the requirements are verifiable.", what does "verifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): kiểm chứng được. "Verifiable requirement" = yêu cầu có thể kiểm tra đúng/sai. Động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked. "Verifiable requirement" is one you can test as met or not. Verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "A development manager treats sign-off as a way to freeze requirements", từ "freeze" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A development manager treats sign-off as a way to freeze requirements", what does "freeze" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: freeze /friːz/ (động từ): cố định, khóa lại. "Freeze requirements" = khóa yêu cầu, không cho đổi. Máy tính "freeze" là bị treo.
items.explanationEn: freeze /friːz/ (verb): to fix, to lock. "Freeze requirements" means lock them against change. A computer that freezes stops responding.

items.question: Trong câu "Both attitudes ignore the reality that it is impossible to know all the requirements early and that requirements will undoubtedly change.", từ "undoubtedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both attitudes ignore the reality that it is impossible to know all the requirements early and that requirements will undoubtedly change.", what does "undoubtedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: undoubtedly /ʌnˈdaʊ.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): chắc chắn. "Undoubtedly" = không nghi ngờ gì, chắc chắn.
items.explanationEn: undoubtedly /ʌnˈdaʊ.tɪd.li/ (adverb): certainly. "Undoubtedly" means without any doubt, certainly.

items.question: Trong câu "More important than the ritual is the concept of a requirements baseline — a snapshot of a reviewed, agreed set of requirements that serves as the basis for further development.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More important than the ritual is the concept of a requirements baseline — a snapshot of a reviewed, agreed set of requirements that serves as the basis for further development.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
options: bản chụp tại một thời điểm
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): bản chụp tại một thời điểm. "A snapshot of" = trạng thái được ghi lại tại một thời điểm. Nghĩa gốc: ảnh chụp nhanh.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): a record at one moment. "A snapshot of" is a record of the state at one moment. Original sense: a quick photo.

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes you cannot obtain sign-off from every relevant stakeholder: logistics, busy schedules, or people reluctant to commit and be held accountable later.", từ "reluctant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes you cannot obtain sign-off from every relevant stakeholder: logistics, busy schedules, or people reluctant to commit and be held accountable later.", what does "reluctant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reluctant /rɪˈlʌk.tənt/ (tính từ): miễn cưỡng. "Reluctant to do something" = ngại, không muốn làm gì. Danh từ: reluctance.
items.explanationEn: reluctant /rɪˈlʌk.tənt/ (adjective): unwilling. "Reluctant to do something" means unwilling to do it. Noun: reluctance.

items.question: Trong câu "Sometimes you cannot obtain sign-off from every relevant stakeholder: logistics, busy schedules, or people reluctant to commit and be held accountable later.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sometimes you cannot obtain sign-off from every relevant stakeholder: logistics, busy schedules, or people reluctant to commit and be held accountable later.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm. "Be held accountable" = bị quy trách nhiệm. Danh từ: accountability.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): responsible for results. "Be held accountable" means be made responsible for outcomes. Noun: accountability.

items.question: Trong câu "If stakeholders fear they will not be able to make changes after approving, they drag their feet — and the project falls into the dreaded trap of analysis paralysis.", từ "drag one's feet" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If stakeholders fear they will not be able to make changes after approving, they drag their feet — and the project falls into the dreaded trap of analysis paralysis.", what does "drag one's feet" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: drag one's feet /dræɡ wʌnz fiːt/ (cụm từ): cố tình trì hoãn. "Drag one's feet" = chần chừ, cố tình làm chậm vì không muốn làm.
items.explanationEn: drag one's feet /dræɡ wʌnz fiːt/ (phrase): to delay on purpose. "Drag one's feet" means be deliberately slow because you do not want to act.

items.question: Trong câu "If stakeholders fear they will not be able to make changes after approving, they drag their feet — and the project falls into the dreaded trap of analysis paralysis.", từ "paralysis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If stakeholders fear they will not be able to make changes after approving, they drag their feet — and the project falls into the dreaded trap of analysis paralysis.", what does "paralysis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: paralysis /pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (danh từ): sự tê liệt, bế tắc. "Analysis paralysis" = phân tích mãi không dám quyết định. Nghĩa y học: bại liệt.
items.explanationEn: paralysis /pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (noun): being unable to act. "Analysis paralysis" means analysing so much that nothing gets decided. Medical sense: loss of movement.

items.question: Trong câu "That is one option, but it really equates to not reaching agreement, and it risks straining the relationship with the very people whose tacit approval you just assumed.", từ "tacit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is one option, but it really equates to not reaching agreement, and it risks straining the relationship with the very people whose tacit approval you just assumed.", what does "tacit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tacit /ˈtæs.ɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm, không nói ra. "Tacit approval" = sự đồng ý ngầm, không nói ra. Trái nghĩa: explicit.
items.explanationEn: tacit /ˈtæs.ɪt/ (adjective): implied, unspoken. "Tacit approval" is agreement that is implied but not stated. Opposite: explicit.

items.question: Trong câu "That is one option, but it really equates to not reaching agreement, and it risks straining the relationship with the very people whose tacit approval you just assumed.", từ "strain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is one option, but it really equates to not reaching agreement, and it risks straining the relationship with the very people whose tacit approval you just assumed.", what does "strain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: strain /streɪn/ (động từ): làm căng thẳng. "Strain a relationship" = làm mối quan hệ căng thẳng. Nghĩa khác: lọc (strain pasta).
items.explanationEn: strain /streɪn/ (verb): to put pressure on. "Strain a relationship" means put it under pressure. Other sense: pour through a sieve.

items.question: Trong câu "Move forward cautiously, on the assumption that you do not have approval from those stakeholders.", từ "cautiously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Move forward cautiously, on the assumption that you do not have approval from those stakeholders.", what does "cautiously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: cautiously /ˈkɔː.ʃəs.li/ (trạng từ): một cách thận trọng. "Proceed cautiously" = tiến hành thận trọng. Tính từ: cautious.
items.explanationEn: cautiously /ˈkɔː.ʃəs.li/ (adverb): carefully. "Proceed cautiously" means go ahead with care. Adjective: cautious.

items.question: Trong câu "The product owner and the team agree in a planning session which stories go into the next iteration, based on priority and the team velocity.", từ "velocity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product owner and the team agree in a planning session which stories go into the next iteration, based on priority and the team velocity.", what does "velocity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: velocity /vəˈlɒs.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tốc độ làm của nhóm. Trong Scrum, "velocity" = lượng công việc nhóm hoàn thành mỗi sprint. Nghĩa vật lý: vận tốc.
items.explanationEn: velocity /vəˈlɒs.ə.ti/ (noun): a team's work rate. In Scrum, "velocity" is how much work a team finishes per iteration. Physics sense: speed in a direction.

items.question: Trong câu "This kept the agile spirit intact: nobody is forced into a corner over a massive document they barely understand, and users keep the right to realise later that they need something new.", từ "intact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This kept the agile spirit intact: nobody is forced into a corner over a massive document they barely understand, and users keep the right to realise later that they need something new.", what does "intact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intact /ɪnˈtækt/ (tính từ): nguyên vẹn. "Keep something intact" = giữ nguyên vẹn, không bị ảnh hưởng.
items.explanationEn: intact /ɪnˈtækt/ (adjective): undamaged, whole. "Keep something intact" means keep it whole and undamaged.

items.question: Trong câu "This kept the agile spirit intact: nobody is forced into a corner over a massive document they barely understand, and users keep the right to realise later that they need something new.", từ "barely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This kept the agile spirit intact: nobody is forced into a corner over a massive document they barely understand, and users keep the right to realise later that they need something new.", what does "barely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: barely /ˈbeə.li/ (trạng từ): hầu như không. "Barely understand" = hầu như không hiểu. Gần nghĩa: hardly, scarcely.
items.explanationEn: barely /ˈbeə.li/ (adverb): hardly. "Barely understand" means understand very little. Synonyms: hardly, scarcely.

items.question: Trong câu "If agreement is missing, log it on the risk list and proceed cautiously rather than treating silence as consent.", từ "consent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If agreement is missing, log it on the risk list and proceed cautiously rather than treating silence as consent.", what does "consent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consent /kənˈsent/ (danh từ): sự đồng ý. "Silence as consent" = coi im lặng là đồng ý. Đừng nhầm với content (nội dung).
items.explanationEn: consent /kənˈsent/ (noun): permission, agreement. "Silence as consent" means taking no reply as a yes. Do not confuse with content.

items.question: Trong câu "If agreement is missing, log it on the risk list and proceed cautiously rather than treating silence as consent.", từ "log" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If agreement is missing, log it on the risk list and proceed cautiously rather than treating silence as consent.", what does "log" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: log /lɒɡ/ (động từ): ghi lại. "Log it on the list" = ghi nó vào danh sách. "Log in" là đăng nhập; danh từ log là khúc gỗ hoặc nhật ký.
items.explanationEn: log /lɒɡ/ (verb): to record. "Log it on the list" means record it there. "Log in" means sign in; the noun log is wood or a record.

items.question: Trong câu "Never use sign-off as a weapon to freeze requirements or to assign blame.", từ "blame" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Never use sign-off as a weapon to freeze requirements or to assign blame.", what does "blame" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: blame /bleɪm/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm lỗi. "Assign blame" = đổ lỗi cho ai. Cũng là động từ: blame someone for something.
items.explanationEn: blame /bleɪm/ (noun): responsibility for a fault. "Assign blame" means say who is at fault. Also a verb: blame someone for something.

items.question: Trong câu "Make two-way expectations explicit through the Bill of Rights and Bill of Responsibilities.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make two-way expectations explicit through the Bill of Rights and Bill of Responsibilities.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, minh bạch. "Make something explicit" = nói rõ ra. Trái nghĩa: implicit, tacit.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. "Make something explicit" means state it clearly. Opposites: implicit, tacit.

items.question: Trong câu "When approval is missing, manage it as a risk rather than pretending it is not.", từ "pretend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When approval is missing, manage it as a risk rather than pretending it is not.", what does "pretend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (động từ): giả vờ. "Pretend (that)..." = giả vờ là... Đừng nhầm với intend (dự định).
items.explanationEn: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (verb): to act as if. "Pretend (that)..." means act as though something is true. Do not confuse with intend.
